05176 Nachash {naw-khawsh'}

與 05175 同; 陽性專有名詞 人名

AV - Nahash 9; 9

拿轄 = "大蛇"
1) 掃羅王時代的一位亞捫人的王 (#撒上 11:1-2;12:12|)
2) 亞比該的父親, 亞比該是亞瑪撒的母親, 亞瑪撒是押沙龍軍隊的指揮官 (#撒下 17:25|)
record.edic_text:
05176 Nachash {naw-khawsh'}

the same as 05175;;

AV - Nahash 9; 9

Nahash = "serpent"
n pr m
1) a king of the Ammonites during the time of king Saul
2) the father of Abigail, the mother of Amasa, the commander of
   Absalom's army
